I am in Iringa where the rains are usually good for maize, so on this small plot I will plant maize with another crop and manage it mostly with family work. I will use some chemical fertilizer if I can get it, but not too much because money is tight, and I will also put manure where I can. I prefer improved seed because it gives better harvest when the rains come well, and I do not plan to irrigate because we depend on the rains. I will not use much pesticide on maize unless there is a serious problem, so for this season I do not plan to use it.
